company.company description: Swift Move Logistics specializes in moving used household goods and office equipment for clients relocating within the Midwest. They offer services such as packing, loading, transit, unloading, and even short-term and long-term storage solutions. Their team handles both local and long-distance relocations, serving individuals and small businesses. The company operates a fleet of trucks tailored for safe and efficient transport, and employs full-time movers, drivers, and logistics personnel.
